Hi Aisha

Thanks for the clear list

Short answers up front:
- Batching + KV caching reduce per-token cost most when you have repeated context or steady concurrency; for chat workloads with reuse we often see 25-50% token cost reduction in practice.
- For gpt-redwood-xl-8k: int8 is the safe default for pilot (good quality + predictable latency). int4 gives additional cost upside but needs validation on LLM quality for your prompts.
- Pilot credits: we usually propose a combination of time-bound credits + an introductory volume discount for a 3-month POC; I'll get exact ranges from our commercial team.

Looping in Laura (commercial) and Karthik (inference lead) to give a concise tradeoff matrix and a pilot credit sketch. Can you confirm: 1) split of chat vs. long-form (rough %), 2) expected concurrency (RPS) during peak?

Also happy to do a short 30-minute call Mon/Tue to walk through the matrix and build something procurement-ready.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the details and for confirming the split (chat ~65%, long-form ~35%, peak concurrency ~120 RPS). Per our internal review I9ve attached a short tradeoff matrix and a pricing summary. Highlights below so procurement can land quickly:

1) Technical recommendations (pilot)
- Model: gpt-redwood-xl-8k pinned to v2.1 for determinism.
- Quantization: int8 runtime recommended for the 3-month pilot (balanced latency + quality). If you want to push cost further after baseline validation, we can run an A/B with int4 on a small subset of prompts to measure quality delta.
- Batching: set target batch_size=64 for GPU workers; dynamic batching with a 15ms collection window keeps p99 under target at ~120RPS in our tests.
- KV caching: enable session-level prefix caching with 12-hour TTL for user sessions — this reduces repeated context costs for chat and preserves freshness.

2) Economic/levers (pilot numbers are illustrative)
- Baseline hosted: $0.0018 / 1k tokens
- Expected combined savings with Optimize (batching + KV caching + int8): 35-50% depending on reuse and concurrency
- Pilot credit proposal: $6,000 in usage credits + 20% introductory discount on overages for the 3-month POC.
- Post-pilot: tiered volume discounts available starting at 50M tokens/month.

3) Next steps / docs
- Attached: optimizer_tradeoff_matrix.xlsx (technical vs econ scenarios) and proposed_pricing_summary.pdf (pilot credit language and AB test notes).
- We'll put a simple SOW + procurement checklist in the HubSpot deal and can generate a DocuSign when you9re ready.

If this looks good I can schedule a 30-min call Wed to walk through the matrix with Karthik and Laura.
